summary: Preschool learning games for ages 2-5: phonics, math, tracing, puzzles & more
description:
Sago Mini School is the best learning app for kindergarten readiness! Discover 300+ school games for kids that develop academic and life skills through play. Easy for kids to navigate independently, Sago Mini School is evidence-backed screen time parents trust. 

NEW! Read-a-LOUD with The Pigeon and best-selling children’s author Mo Willems, including fan-favorite books The Pigeon HAS to Go to School, and more!

• FUN & EDUCATIONAL GAMES FOR AGES 2-5
• AD-FREE & NO IN-APP PURCHASES
• DESIGNED WITH CHILD DEVELOPMENT EXPERTS
• TRY IT FREE FOR 7 DAYS!

With tons of school games for kids in 30+ topics, preschoolers spark an early love of learning. From practicing phonics in read-aloud stories, solving math puzzles, or developing fine motor skills in tracing activities, there’s so much to do!

• COUNT forward and backward, and identify numbers.
• READ ALOUD, write, practice phonics & letter tracing.
• PRACTICE mindfulness and build social-emotional skills. 
• SOLVE puzzles and learn problem solving. 
• DISCOVER how the world works through STEM.
• PREPARE for the classroom with school games for kids, phonics, and read aloud stories.
• LEARN shapes and colors with tracing and drawing.

**Sago Mini School is part of the Piknik bundle – one subscription, endless ways to play and learn! Get full access to the world's best apps for kids from Toca Boca, Sago Mini, and Originator with an Unlimited Plan.**
